name: Mount Diablo fairy-lantern
desc: Mount Diablo fairy-lantern (Calochortus pulchellus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 938 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Calochortus pulchellus is a rare species of flowering plant in the lily family known by the common name Mt. Diablo fairy-lantern or Mount Diablo globelily.
